title: warden.decision.v1
description: One line of a Warden worker's JSON decision stream (audit.jsonLog): one JSON object per stored analytics event, newline-delimited. Versioning: v1 accepts only additive optional fields, each with a schema_rev bump; the Go record (internal/auditlog), this schema and the docs change in the same pull request. A breaking change ships as warden.decision.v2 next to v1 for one minor release. Consumers must ignore unknown fields. Time and ordering: ts is the producing worker's wall clock at event time and may skew across workers; lines are not ordered, so consumers must sort by ts, never by line order. seq orders lines within one boot_id, and a gap in seq means lines were dropped (the SQLite store and signed receipts stay the record of truth). url_path is the escaped path only and never holds query values; query_keys, when enabled, holds parameter names only. Fields not listed here are deliberately never exported (secret references, scan evidence, bodies, headers).

schema_rev.description: Revision within v1; bumped when an additive optional field is added.

ts.description: UTC RFC 3339 with nanoseconds; the worker's wall clock at event time. Sort by this.

proxy_id.description: The worker that wrote the line.

proxy_id_source.description: Where proxy_id came from (for example config or hostname).

agent_id.description: The wrapped agent this worker serves.

boot_id.description: Random per-process id; seq restarts at 1 for each boot_id.

seq.description: Per-boot line counter; a gap means dropped lines.

reason.description: Bounded decision reason: always set on deny, empty or absent on allow unless a monitor-mode finding rode one. Either a declared reason or an mcp_chain_<pattern> reason.

protocol.description: Transport or protocol, for example https, http, mcp, grpc, ws.

method.description: HTTP method, empty for non-HTTP paths.

url_path.description: Escaped request path only: no scheme, host, userinfo, fragment or query values.

query_keys.description: Sorted, de-duplicated query parameter names; present only when audit.jsonLog.query is keys. Never values.

tool.description: MCP tool name, empty for non-MCP events.

provider.description: LLM provider the call was attributed to, empty when none.

cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in US dollars; never billing-grade.

dlp_action.description: DLP action: allow, block, redact or monitor; empty when DLP is off.

dlp_rule.description: DLP rule that fired, empty when none.

dlp_partial.description: True when only part of the body was scanned.

data_classes.description: Detected DLP data class names; never matched content.

swapped_refs.description: Placeholder names that were swapped; never real secret values.

compliance.description: Framework control ids this event maps to, for example mitre:T1048.

judge_reason.description: The LLM judge's rationale with control characters removed, cut to 512 bytes.

user.description: Verified end-user attribution. status is set whenever the event carried an identity status; every other field only when status is valid. The object is absent when the event carries no identity status, which is every event of a worker with identity off.

status.description: Identity verification status: valid, invalid, expired, unverified, conflict, or none (identity is on and the request carried no token). Open string, no enum, so a later status does not break readers.

sub.description: Subject claim; only when status is valid.

email.description: Email claim; only when status is valid.

groups.description: Group claims, capped at 64 entries; only when status is valid.

groups_truncated.description: True when groups was capped here or by the verifier.

sid.description: Session id claim; only when status is valid.

truncated.description: True when optional fields were dropped to keep the line under 16 KiB.
